title: Customer contract review under ASC 606 and ASC 842
prompt: Review a customer contract and amendments against ASC 606 and ASC 842. Summarize relevant terms, accounting alternatives, missing facts and a preliminary conclusion.

setup.q: Which revenue and lease accounting policies has the entity adopted (practical expedients, portfolio approach, materiality)?
Who signs off accounting conclusions for this entity?

inputs.name: Contract record and revenue recognition schedule in Dime

steps: read the contract and every amendment; extract parties, term, deliverables, pricing, payment terms, variable consideration, termination and any right to use an identified asset
identify the performance obligations under ASC 606 and whether an embedded lease exists under ASC 842, citing the paragraphs relied on and marking each citation "verify"
set out the accounting alternatives with the facts each depends on; list the facts that are missing
compare with the entity's accountingPolicies and the contract record in Dime where one exists
write the memo with a preliminary conclusion only where the facts support one, addressed to signoffOwner, and the workbook with the contract figures

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The memo exists as a pdf
Every exception row (a missing fact, a term needing judgement) cites the contract clause or amendment page
contract-review.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
